title: An arm that draws, then lifts, then a leg: checked before it's printed
summary: A SCARA arm sized from its task, the same parts upright with a gripper and a Z axis, and a leg from the arm's gearbox, with reach, speed, an error budget, bearing and link loads, wiring, a shopping list and a build page from one assembly. Predictions only so far: nothing has been printed or moved
